decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-dc7503345583] describes one concrete change. The subject is container image signature verification for the sigstore bundle format. The change is that 1.13 adds it as a new verification type, `SigstoreBundle`, which lets GitHub Artifact Attestations be verified. The excerpt describes this only as new support and mentions no removal or change to existing behaviour, so an engineer could write applicability as "only environments whose policies use the new verification type," with a consequence of none for operators who do nothing. The exact policy field path is cut off in the excerpt, and the two rendered diffs [ev-ea3f83a6e087] [ev-bcf9822c2eb4] are about an unrelated Service appProtocol change, so confidence stays low.
